description: Run your Emby media server from workflows: search and list films, shows and music, see who is watching what, message, pause or stop a player, scan libraries, fix an item's details, manage playlists, collections and users, and read the activity log. Start a workflow when something is added, playback starts or stops, someone finishes a film, a sign-in fails or a user is added.

emby_item_played_trigger.description: Runs when a user finishes a film or episode, or marks one played, such as to log it or line up the next one. What was played before the workflow is turned on doesn't run it.

parameters.description: Only this user, by name or ID. Leave blank for everyone on the server.
parameters.name: user

parameters.description: Only this kind of item: one of movies, shows, episodes, albums, artists, songs, music_videos, other_videos, collections, playlists, books, audiobooks, photos. Leave blank for films and episodes.
parameters.name: item_type

emby_new_activity_trigger.description: Runs for each new entry in Emby's activity log: a sign-in or a failed one, a user added or removed, a plugin or server update, a scheduled task that failed.

parameters.description: Only entries of this type, as Emby writes it: user.authenticationfailed for a failed sign-in, user.authenticated, user.lockedout, user.created, user.deleted, user.passwordchanged, playback.start, playback.stop, plugin.installed, scheduledtask.failed or system.update.installed. Leave blank for every entry.
parameters.name: activity_type

emby_new_item_trigger.description: Runs when a film, episode, album or other item is added to Emby, by a library scan, with its details. Items already there when the workflow is turned on don't run it.

parameters.description: Only this kind of item: one of movies, shows, episodes, albums, artists, songs, music_videos, other_videos, collections, playlists, books, audiobooks, photos. Leave blank for films, episodes and albums.
parameters.name: item_type

parameters.description: Only items added to this library, by name or ID. Leave blank for every library.
parameters.name: library

emby_new_user_trigger.description: Runs when a user is added to the server, such as to welcome them or tell an administrator.

emby_playback_started_trigger.description: Runs when someone starts playing a film, episode or song on any device, with who, what and, while it is still playing, the session to message or pause.

parameters.description: Only this user, by name or ID. Leave blank for everyone on the server.
parameters.name: user

emby_playback_stopped_trigger.description: Runs when someone stops playing a film, episode or song, or it ends, with who and what.

parameters.description: Only this user, by name or ID. Leave blank for everyone on the server.
parameters.name: user
